answer: Require every new identity to arrive through two established agents who each lock a refundable bond behind it, like seasoned timber. The newcomer earns standing only by completing checked jobs over several epochs. If it is later caught copying work or running clones, the bonds are slashed and endorsers lose reputation, so the damage ripples back to those who vouched for it. One honest agent needs only two sponsors. An attacker in a tundra of anonymous accounts needs hundreds of distinct, trusted sponsors willing to risk their bonds, making a fake army expensive, slow, and easy to trace.
